services.desc: Fishing fun starts at Tidal Pursuits Fishing. Our fishing charter company offers guided fishing trips throughout Nags Head and the Outer Banks, taking you to the best fishing destinations in the Outer Banks. No matter the time of year, we can help you reel in the perfect catch. services.name: Set Sail on a 21-Foot Sea Pro Boat
services.desc: At Tidal Pursuits Fishing, we operate a 2001 21-foot Sea Pro center console that’s powered by a 150 HP Mercury outboard motor. Equipped with a jack plate and trolling motor, our boat can quietly navigate shallow waters, making it ideal for sight casting to a wide range of fish species. It can also accommodate up to four anglers, with ample seating for the journey between fishing spots. Additionally, it features an upper control station/tower and provides plenty of storage space for rods, tackle and personal items.
